prompt:
Revise the draft below. Fix only these problems and keep everything else the same
(structure, tone, length and format):
- It uses numbers that are not in the facts: 15. Remove them or use only numbers from the facts. Do not quote prices, budgets, hours or timelines.

Facts you may rely on:
Sales KPI dashboard (2021-02 to 2021-04): One Power BI report on a star-schema model replacing 14 separate Excel sales reports. Stack: Power BI, DAX, SQL Server, Excel. Results: 14 reports consolidated into 1; monthly close reporting from 3 days to 4 hours.
Inventory reconciliation automation (2021-10 to 2021-12): A Power Query workbook that matches warehouse counts to the ERP every week and flags variances. Stack: Excel, Power Query, SQL. Results: $86k of stock variance found; weekly reconciliation from 6 hours to 20 minutes.
5 years of experience.

<draft>

I have 5 years’ experience in data analysis and dashboarding, and I’ve built reporting systems that improve decision-making fast. My tools are SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, and data cleaning/visualization workflows. I can review your Excel Ad report, comment on what can be improved, and provide weekly reports plus a call every 2 weeks. I can commit 10–15 hours per week and start at the end of February.
